Of the 3 parashah marks inside oshb:Ezek.29.1-Ezek.29.16 (3 verses: after 29:7, 29:12, 29:16) none falls at this close. Seam stands; high does not.

What denies the internal seam at oshb:Ezek.30.9/oshb:Ezek.30.10 (samekh after 30:9, messenger formula at 30:10, the human agent first named there) is the intervening verse between the refrain at oshb:Ezek.30.8 and that formula, not the absence of a therefore-clause, which is the test the notes name; the same immediacy test is what licenses this unit's own close at oshb:Ezek.30.12. The span also runs 12 verses against the ruled 7-to-10 band.

unresolved_uncertainty: Inside the dateline block oshb:Ezek.29.1-Ezek.29.16 the witness divides after 29:7, 29:12 and 29:16, while the two units covering the block divide at 29:9/29:10 - the one internal boundary there carrying no mark. An alternative two-unit tiling closing at 29:7 and opening at 29:8 (therefore-plus-messenger-formula onset, reed-staff figure complete at 29:7, samekh behind it) would put both seams on marked, formula-corroborated ground. It is not proposed here, because a refrain closes the unit before it and a mark never cuts alone, but one lens cannot close the question.

The year-27 date at oshb:Ezek.29.17 is the latest date in the book only within the exile reckoning; the thirtieth-year figure at oshb:Ezek.1.1 belongs to a different system, so the superlative needs its reckoning named alongside it.

The notes of the unit spanning oshb:Ezek.29.17-Ezek.29.21 already carry one of the saturated seven-word runs, the one denying punctuation-layer marks in a span. Any rewording of that unit should replace the run rather than repeat it; no prose written here reuses any run on the list.

Whether the Israel-facing coda at oshb:Ezek.29.21, with its mouth-opening promise, owes a disclosure of the arc running from oshb:Ezek.3.26 through oshb:Ezek.24.27 to oshb:Ezek.33.22. The arc is a driving text signal rather than a formula device, so the duty is unsettled; it moves no seam, because a one-verse unit there is barred.

The strategy's held-region posture for this stretch is medium_low or low. The confidence move proposed at oshb:Ezek.29.1-Ezek.29.9 is one step, to medium, on the strength of the dateline onset; a reviewer weighting the held-region posture more heavily could argue medium_low.
